## simulating one guess

- need to sample from the words that meet those conditions
- or go for consonants vowels???
- use letters we already used

```{r, wordle_game1}
random <- sample(words, 2, replace = FALSE)
answer <- str_split(random[1], pattern="") #answer
answer
guess <- str_split(random[2], pattern="") #first guess
guess


### check if any letters / positions same as answer

reveal <- c()
answer <- as.vector(answer)

for (i in 1:5) {
  
 # check and place green
  if (guess[[1]][i] == answer[[1]][i]){
    reveal[i] = "green" 
  } else if (guess[[1]][i] %in% answer[[1]] & guess[[1]][i] != answer[[1]][i]) {
    reveal[i] = "yellow"
  } else {
    reveal[i] = "grey"
  }
  
}

reveal

##### guess 2 - from chatgpt

# Start with all possible words
possible_words <- words

for (i in 1:5) {

  if (reveal[i] == "green") {

    # Green: letter must be in the same position
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      substr(possible_words, i, i) == guess[[1]][i]
    ]

  } else if (reveal[i] == "yellow") {

    # Yellow: letter must be in the word, but not this position
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      grepl(guess[[1]][i], possible_words) &
      substr(possible_words, i, i) != guess[[1]][i]
    ]

  } else {

    # Grey: letter cannot be in the word
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      !grepl(guess[[1]][i], possible_words)
    ]

  }
}

# Randomly select a possible second guess
guess2 <- sample(possible_words, 1)

guess2


##### check guess 2

guess2 <- str_split(guess2, pattern = "")[[1]]

reveal2 <- c()

for (i in 1:5) {
  
  if (guess2[i] == answer[[1]][i]) {
    reveal2[i] <- "green"
  } else if (guess2[i] %in% answer[[1]]) {
    reveal2[i] <- "yellow"
  } else {
    reveal2[i] <- "grey"
  }
  
}

reveal2
```

# First Strategy: Complete Randomness

Out of all legal words, how often do you win by making guesses that have no influence on other guesses?

```{r}
absolute_randomness <- function(){
  guesses <- c()
  answer_random <- sample(words, 1)
  for (i in 1:6){
    guesses[i] <- sample(words, 1)
  }
  if (any(guesses == answer_random)){
    return(TRUE)
  }
  else{
  return(FALSE)
  }
}
nsim <- 10000
(sum(replicate(nsim, absolute_randomness())) / nsim)
```

# Second Strategy: Randomly selecting from possible words 

If we remove the grayed out letters from each incorrect guess:

```{r}
answer <- str_split(random[1], pattern="") #answer
answer
guess <- str_split(random[2], pattern="") #first guess
guess

alphabet <- letters
  
for (i in 1:5) {
  # check and place green
  if (guess[[1]][i] == answer[[1]][i]){
    reveal[i] = "green" 
  } else if (guess[[1]][i] %in% answer[[1]] & guess[[1]][i] != answer[[1]][i]) {
    reveal[i] = "yellow"
  } else {
    reveal[i] = "grey"
  }
}

reveal
guess[[1]][1]

#remove invalid letters from alphabet 

for (i in 1:length(reveal)){
  if (reveal[i] == "grey"){
    alphabet <- alphabet[alphabet != guess[[1]][i]]
  }
}
length(alphabet)


```
